definitions.explanation: A country that belongs to an international organization, treaty, or alliance. Frequently used in the context of the United Nations, EU, and other international bodies.

examples.japanese: EU{加盟国|かめいこく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{二十七|にじゅうなな}か{国|こく}⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
⟦{新|あら}た→新た：01697_arata⟧な{加盟国|かめいこく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{迎|むか}えた→迎える：01193_mukaeru⟧。
examples.english: A new member state was welcomed.

examples.japanese: ⟦{国連|こくれん}→国連：12035_kokuren⟧{加盟国|かめいこく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{代表|だいひょう}→代表：03419_daihyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{総会|そうかい}→総会：13855_soukai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{集|あつ}まった→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧。
examples.english: Representatives from UN member states gathered at the general assembly.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{加盟|かめい}→加盟：05769_kamei⟧ (joining, affiliation) + {国|こく} (country). Usually preceded by the organization's name.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{国連|こくれん}→国連：12035_kokuren⟧{加盟国|かめいこく}: a UN member state
- EU{加盟国|かめいこく}, NATO{加盟国|かめいこく}: an EU or NATO member
- {加盟国|かめいこく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{義務|ぎむ}→義務：02647_gimu⟧: the obligations of member states
- {加盟国|かめいこく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{増|ふ}やす→増やす：02410_fuyasu⟧: to add member states

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{同盟国|どうめいこく}→同盟国：22005_doumeikoku⟧: ally — a country bound by an alliance, not simply a member of an organization
